verses.translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.

tokens.irab: حرف توكيد ونصب مبني على الفتح، و(نا) ضمير متصل مبني في محل نصب اسم إن

ai_explanations.beginner: Inna means 'Indeed We'. Allah uses 'We' to show His supreme power and majesty.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Compound of the emphatic particle Inna + attached pronoun Na (first-person plural of majesty), serving as Ism Inna.
ai_explanations.advanced: The plural of majesty (نون العظمة) emphasizes the grandeur of the Giver before mentioning the gift, instilling awe.

syntax_tree.description: The verbal sentence functions as the predicate of Inna.

similar_quran_examples.explanation: Inna + Plural of Majesty introducing the Quran
Inna + Plural of Majesty promising victory

tokens.tooltip: Verb (Past Form IV) + Subject + Object: We have granted you
tokens.irab: فعل ماض مبني على السكون لاتصاله بنا الفاعلين، و(نا) فاعل، والكاف ضمير متصل مبني في محل نصب مفعول به أول، والجملة في محل رفع خبر إن

ai_explanations.beginner: A'tayna means 'We gave', and 'ka' means 'to you' (Prophet Muhammad ﷺ).
ai_explanations.intermediate: Form IV past active verb (أَفْعَلَ) with attached subject pronoun Na and attached direct object pronoun Ka.
ai_explanations.advanced: Form IV denotes total conferral. Past tense guarantees certainty: though realized in Paradise, the gift is already decreed.

syntax_tree.description: Allah is the supreme Giver performing the bestowal.
The Prophet ﷺ is the honored recipient (Maf'ul bihi 1).
Al-Kawthar is the second direct object (Maf'ul bihi 2).
The verbal sentence functions as the predicate of Inna.

similar_quran_examples.explanation: Promise of divine giving until complete satisfaction

tokens.tooltip: Noun (Mansub): The Abundance / River in Paradise
tokens.irab: مفعول به ثان منصوب وعلامة نصبه الفتحة الظاهرة على آخره

ai_explanations.beginner: Al-Kawthar means 'abundance'—all good in this life and the river in Paradise.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Noun in accusative case (mansoob) on pattern Faw'al (فَوْعَل) derived from root kaf-tha-ra (abundance).
ai_explanations.advanced: Pattern Faw'al signifies infinite multiplicity: not merely a lot, but a self-replenishing fountain of spiritual and material grace.

syntax_tree.description: Al-Kawthar is the second direct object (Maf'ul bihi 2).

similar_quran_examples.explanation: Competition in increase

verses.translation: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

tokens.irab: الفاء فصيحة أو سببية رابطة لجواب شرط مقدر مبنية على الفتح

ai_explanations.beginner: Fa means 'So' or 'Therefore'. It connects the gift to our duty of gratitude.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Consequential particle (Fa al-Sababiyyah). Links divine bounty to immediate devotional response.
ai_explanations.advanced: Functions as Fa al-Fasiha; unrolls an implicit premise: 'Since you have been granted limitless abundance, then pray.'

syntax_tree.description: Causal connector: gratitude through devotion follows abundance.

tokens.irab: فعل أمر مبني على حذف حرف العلة (الياء)، والفاعل ضمير مستتر تقديره أنت

ai_explanations.beginner: Salli means 'Pray!'. Prayer is our highest expression of thanks.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Form II imperative verb (فَعِّلْ). Built on deletion of final weak vowel (harf al-'illah).
ai_explanations.advanced: Form II implies intensive, consistent devotion. In Islamic jurisprudence, encompasses the Eid prayer and all obligations.

syntax_tree.description: Causal connector: gratitude through devotion follows abundance.
Prayer is dedicated exclusively to the Lord.

similar_quran_examples.explanation: Remembering the Lord and praying

tokens.tooltip: Preposition + Noun + Pronoun: For your Lord alone
tokens.irab: اللام حرف جر للاختصاص، رب اسم مجرور بالكسرة وهو مضاف، والكاف مضاف إليه، والجار والمجرور متعلقان بـ صَلّ

ai_explanations.beginner: Li-Rabbika means 'for your Lord'. Worship Allah alone, with total sincerity.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Preposition Lam (indicating exclusivity/Ikhlas) + noun Rabb in genitive + attached pronoun Ka as Mudaf Ilayh.
ai_explanations.advanced: Rabb invokes divine nurturing care and lordship. Directly counters pagan rituals dedicated to idols.

syntax_tree.description: Prayer is dedicated exclusively to the Lord.
Idafah of ownership and affectionate closeness.

similar_quran_examples.text: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
similar_quran_examples.explanation: Prayer and sacrifice dedicated solely to Allah

tokens.tooltip: Conjunction + Verb (Imperative Form I): And sacrifice!
tokens.irab: الواو عاطفة، وانحر فعل أمر مبني على السكون، والفاعل ضمير مستتر تقديره أنت، والجملة معطوفة على صل

ai_explanations.beginner: Wanhar means 'and sacrifice'. Giving food and charity to thank Allah.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Conjunction Waw + Form I imperative verb on pattern If'al (اِفْعَلْ), built on Sukun.
ai_explanations.advanced: Nahr specifically designates camel sacrifice (the most valuable livestock in Arabia), embodying sincere physical and wealth surrender.

similar_quran_examples.text: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَـٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ
similar_quran_examples.explanation: Sacrificial camels as sacred symbols

verses.translation: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

tokens.irab: حرف توكيد ونصب مبني على الفتح ينصب الاسم ويرفع الخبر

ai_explanations.beginner: Inna means 'Indeed'. It guarantees that Allah's declaration is certain.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Particle of emphasis and accusative governance (Harf Tawkeed wa Nasb).
ai_explanations.advanced: Re-opening verse 3 with Inna reinforces absolute divine reassurance against enemy slander.

syntax_tree.description: Shani'aka is the accusative subject of Inna.
Al-Abtar is the nominative predicate of Inna.

tokens.tooltip: Active Participle (Ism Inna) + Pronoun: Your hater / enemy
tokens.irab: اسم إن منصوب وعلامة نصبه الفتحة الظاهرة وهو مضاف، والكاف ضمير متصل مبني في محل جر مضاف إليه

ai_explanations.beginner: Shani'aka means 'your hater'. The pagan leaders who mocked the Prophet.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Active participle (Ism Fa'il) on pattern Fa'il serving as Ism Inna in accusative, with attached pronoun Ka.
ai_explanations.advanced: Root shin-nun-hamza denotes spiteful enmity. The active participle denotes ongoing malice that condemns the perpetrator.

syntax_tree.description: Shani'aka is the accusative subject of Inna.

similar_quran_examples.explanation: Hatred of a people

tokens.irab: ضمير فصل مبني على الفتح لا محل له من الإعراب يفيد التوكيد والحصر

ai_explanations.beginner: Huwa means 'he is the one'. It directs the blame strictly onto the hater.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Separation pronoun (Damir Fasl). Distinguishes subject from predicate and produces exclusivity.
ai_explanations.advanced: Rhetorical restriction (Hasr): 'He—and he alone—is the one severed from all legacy, not you!'

similar_quran_examples.explanation: Damir Fasl highlighting exclusivity

tokens.tooltip: Adjective (Khabar Inna): The one cut off without legacy
tokens.meaning: the one cut off from all good and progeny
tokens.irab: خبر إن مرفوع وعلامة رفعه الضمة الظاهرة على آخره

ai_explanations.beginner: Al-Abtar means 'cut off'. While the enemy is forgotten, the Prophet's name is remembered forever.
ai_explanations.intermediate: Adjective on pattern Af'al (أَفْعَل) functioning as Khabar Inna in nominative (marfoo' with Dhumma).
ai_explanations.advanced: Batar means total severance. History fulfilled this prophecy: the mockers vanished, while billions send blessings on Muhammad ﷺ daily.

syntax_tree.description: Al-Abtar is the nominative predicate of Inna.

similar_quran_examples.explanation: And We raised high for you your repute

ontology.description: Infinite spiritual, worldly, and celestial bounties granted to the Prophet ﷺ.
Sovereign bestowal marked by permanent confirmation.
Pure prayer fulfilling the purpose of thanksgiving.
Devotion through economic and physical sacrifice for Allah and humanity.
Active malice and mocking toward divine truth and the Prophet.
God overturning the slurs of the oppressors, rendering them forgotten.

balaghah.effect: Causal consequence: because Allah gave you boundless abundance, wholehearted worship is the only fitting reply.
Sublime balance: divine gift meets human devotion, followed by guaranteed protection from mockery.
The pattern Faw'al expresses overwhelming, limitless multiplicity that cannot be depleted.
Pronoun of separation creates definitive restriction: 'He—and he alone—is the one cut off!'
A triumphant, resonant ending echoing divine sovereignty and justice.

aqidah.lesson: Allah directly comforts, validates, and defends His Messenger against smear campaigns.
Prayer and sacrifice must be purely dedicated to Allah alone (لِرَبِّكَ), rejecting polytheism.
Those who oppose the message of truth will ultimately face eradication of their legacy.
